title: Watermelon Frose
description: Rose ice cubes, watermelon, lime juice, and basil simple syrup are blended together in this recipe for summer's trendiest drink, frose!

steps.text: Pour rose wine into ice cube trays. Freeze until solid, 8 hours to overnight.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread out watermelon cubes so they are not touching. Freeze until firm, at least 2 hours. Transfer to a resealable plastic bag. Return to the freezer.

Combine water and sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly until sugar dissolves, 2 to 3 minutes. Add basil; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let steep for 15 minutes. Strain simple syrup into a jar with a lid. Discard basil leaves. Place in the refrigerator.
Place rose ice cubes, frozen watermelon, chilled simple syrup, and lime juice in a large blender; blend until combined and smooth. Pour into glasses.

video.description: Whether for a special brunch or an elegant summer porch party, these tasty and natural slushies will be a summer highlight! All you need to do is a little planning ahead to freeze cubes of watermelon on a tray and a dark rosé wine in ice cube trays. Make a simple syrup by boiling sugar and water together and adding basil for a beautiful, herbal note. Strain and add to blender along with rosé ice cubes, frozen watermelon and lime juice. Blend until smooth and serve in your favorite cocktail-style glass garnished with lime or basil.
